analysis: The PR changes only CHANGELOG.md (patch at lines 1-12 of head). It adds two Unreleased entries: (1) removal of emails, IPs, device serials and MDA UDIDs from coordinator logs, with the access log now using user_id and no remote field, and the MDM webhook debug line dropping its body preview; (2) a provider fix giving each system-tool output reader its own serial queue to avoid a hang. No source code is supplied, so the implementation of these claims cannot be verified here. The logging entry reduces identifier exposure, which is relevant to T-058 and TB-009's log and identifier-linking concerns. It does not conflict with the threat model, and no mitigation or assumption is weakened. Possible threat-model follow-up: the header comment says App Attest account, machine and credential IDs still enter logs and Datadog. The changelog says account_id and provider_id are retained, and the threat model should stay consistent with that residual if it is not already. The tool-reader change is an availability fix with no trust-boundary change. The next pass should check the actual log and provider code if it is present in other batches. This pass reviewed only documentation, so it makes no claim about the code that implements it.
